I fixed the orders table in `site/orders.html`. It had five column headers but six cells in every row. The "Total" header was missing, so the headers sat over the wrong columns and the last column had no header.

I added `<th class="num">Total</th>` between Status and Actions. The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't open the page in a browser, so I haven't checked the layout visually.

If something else on the page still looks off, tell me what you're seeing.

STATUS: DONE
